basic_details.job_title: District Court Bijnor Junior Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Court Bijnor has notified 10 vacancies for the Junior Assistant post under advertisement number 570, offering engagement on a contract basis for a tenure of 1 year or until attaining the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier. The engagement is meant for retired employees of District Court Bijnor or other district courts in Uttar Pradesh, who must possess the required retired status. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit their filled application forms in the prescribed format along with required enclosures by hand at the administrative office: प्रशासकिय कार्यालय, जनपद न्यायाधीश, बिजनौर (Prashasakik Karyalay, Janpad Nyayadhish, Bijnor) The application must reach the office on or before 30 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Must be a retired employee from District Court Bijnor or any other district court in Uttar Pradesh. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form format (प्रारूप) filled completely. Certified copies of the character roll (चरित्र पंजिका) for the last five years. Last pay certificate and last pension certificate (only for employees retiring from district courts other than Bijnor). Self-attested photocopies of the self A.O.R. for the last five years (only for employees from other district courts).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Re-employment is considered for retired staff based on the rules. The working tenure is for one year or until attaining 65 years of age, whichever is earlier, subject to the employee being fully healthy and capable of working, with no pending or registered criminal cases against them.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted strictly in the format prescribed by the office. Incomplete applications or those received after the stipulated date and time will not be accepted. Applicants must attach character rolls for the past five years along with the application form. Retired employees from other district courts must attach their last pay certificate, pension certificate, and self-attested photocopies of A.O.R. for the last five years. Applicants must be in sound health, capable of performing duties, and free from any pending or registered criminal cases. The notice copy is displayed on the office notice board, uploaded to the official district court website, and sent to the District Information Officer, Bijnor, for free publication in newspapers.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies available for the Junior Assistant post under District Court Bijnor Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 30 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees from District Court Bijnor or other district courts in Uttar Pradesh are eligible to apply for re-employment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by hand at the administrative office of the District Judge, Bijnor.

faq.question: Q5. What is the duration of engagement for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The engagement tenure is for a period of one year or until attaining the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier, or until new regular appointments or promotions are made.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What documents need to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach the prescribed application form, character rolls for the last five years, and last pay/pension certificates along with self A.O.R. copies (for employees from other district courts).

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: The application form must be submitted to the Prashasakik Karyalay, Janpad Nyayadhish, Bijnor.

faq.question: Q9. What are the health and character requirements for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be fully healthy, capable of working, and have no pending or registered criminal cases against them.
